ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

2. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

3. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 7

4. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

5. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

7. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x > 5
   D. x = 5

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 36

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 41
   C. 31
   D. 43

10. Solve for x: x + 9 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 9
   C. 4
   D. 5

11. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 73
   D. 1

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15

13. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 15
   D. 1

14. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

16. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

17. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 40

18. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

19. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

20. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

21. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 9

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 14
   C. 22
   D. 33

23. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

24. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
